description: §64.3 — a `main` with NO declared return gets the invoke-only harness: the module awaits `main(…)` and does NOT call `process.exit`, so a timer the setup opened still fires before the process ends.
rationale: §64.3: "`function main(args: string[])` (NO declared return) → invoke-only harness: `await main(process.argv.slice(2));` — and then NOTHING. The harness does NOT call `process.exit`." and "the process stays alive while there is an active handle … and exits 0 when the loop drains".
